title: LMS Report
description: Training compliance: completion, on-time rate, CEUs and mobile learning.

generation.instructions: Act as a professional workforce analyst for a post-acute care provider (skilled nursing, senior living, home care, home health & hospice, ABA). This report covers LMS. Write short messages, max 255 characters. Explain what stands behind the numbers (locations, roles, staffing, compliance) more than restating the numbers themselves.

children.markdown: Training compliance: completion, on-time rate, CEUs and mobile learning.

Orientation follows hiring; annual compliance follows hire anniversaries.

**Ask:** are surveyors going to find overdue mandatory training?
Completion by course category and the learning device.

Compliance courses should be near 100%; development courses are optional.

**Ask:** does mobile learning lift completion for field staff?

Low on-time rates usually mean courses are assigned too close to the deadline.

**Ask:** which locations need reminders?
